EasyEDA's FPC-05F-20PH20 model ends its contact tails at y -1.26 mm while the pads run -1.92..-0.67: the tails cover under half of each pad and a 0.45 mm slide centres them, so render/STEP show the connector 0.45 mm off; the board's library model, not an hwde misreading

the ESP32 drives BCK 98 mm to three loads (U10 ES9018K2M, U12 PCM5102A, U13 ES7243E) with no series resistor; at a ~2 ns GPIO edge the line is past its ~58 mm critical length, so the edge rings at each receiver and can double-clock the I2S bit clock. The usual fix is 22-33 ohm in series at U7
In2's +3V3 plane, the reference under this B.Cu run, is cut by /linein/ADC_RN routed on In2 right under BCK; the return current detours round the cut, and the clock also crosses an analog input there
